description: This file contains a utility function 'aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost' that aggregates usage and cost data for agents across two MongoDB collections ('session_tracking' and 'llm-costs'). It includes functions for parsing currency strings, constructing aggregation pipelines, executing database aggregations, and merging results into a summary of agent costs and usage.
